must_catch.item: Value proof is named as the underlying cause behind the No decision tag.
"Nothing we could have done" is labeled opinion and challenged.
The payback request one month before the freeze is surfaced as the turning point.
The revenue framing is reported as pushed back.

fails: Decider insight claims the economic buyer 'had only ever seen us through a generic ROI deck'. The transcript never says Diane saw the deck, and the report's own close lists this as an open question.
data.notes: The report correctly makes the payback request a month before the freeze the turning point, ties it to the generic ROI deck, and builds messaging changes that match all four of the key's directions with solid evidence. Its biggest miss is that the rep's 'It's timing... nothing we could have done' is challenged in the prose but never cited or labelled as opinion in the evidence. It also leaves out 'I don't think anyone told her what it was costing,' doesn't cite the freeze itself as evidence in the decider section, and doesn't separate the value gap (this cycle) from the migration gap (next cycle).
